summary: B-16 frontend-only verification of login lockout on Expo web preview (375x667). PASS: wrong password -> 'Invalid credentials' in login-error (attempts 1-4, HTTP 401, progressive delays observed 1.1s/1.6s/2.6s/4.6s); 5th wrong attempt -> HTTP 429 and login-error shows exactly 'Too many failed sign-in attempts. Please try again in 15 minutes.' (8.6s response); correct password while locked -> HTTP 429, same lockout message, user stays on /login. Message is readable (rgb(180,35,24) 14px on white card, wraps to 2 lines, no overflow) and is NOT the generic 'Login failed' fallback, confirming _extractError handles structured detail. Successful login for voicetest2026@example.com -> HTTP 200 and navigates past login (no regression). 'Continue as guest' -> HTTP 200 -> /consent?mode=update (works). 'Continue with Google' -> redirects to accounts.google.com via Emergent auth (works). Auto-unlock after 15 min not tested in UI (time-bound; covered by backend tests). No deprecated expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) in package.json.

ui_bugs.component: Global Help FAB over login password field
ui_bugs.issue: On 375px viewport the floating global-help-button (x 273-359, y 482-527) sits on top of the password show/hide toggle; document.elementFromPoint at the toggle's centre returns global-help-button, so tapping the eye icon opens Help instead of toggling visibility. Pre-existing, not caused by B-16.

issues: Lock-tripping 5th attempt takes ~8.6s with only a 0.6 opacity on Sign In and no spinner/'Checking…' text; consider an ActivityIndicator so the progressive delay doesn't look like a hang.

action_items: Move/offset the global-help-button on the login screen (or add bottom/right inset) so it does not cover toggle-password-visibility on small phones.
Optional: show a loading indicator on login-submit-button during the progressive delay.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.tsx _extractError correctly handles string, structured-object {message}, and Pydantic array detail; login() uses it. loginWithGoogle native path still uses (await r.json()).detail directly — would show '[object Object]' if a structured detail were ever returned there (not reachable for B-16 today).

Per-IP dimension depends on X-Forwarded-For; across separate browser sessions in this preview the egress IP differed (second session logged in voicetest2026 with 200 while ip:136.108.30.124 was still locked), so per-IP lock is not consistently observable from the UI here — environment-related, backend tests cover it.
